positions.title: Software Developer Engineer II
positions.description:
Ticket Analytics Project
• Architected and productionized GenAI-based machine learning (ML) model for support ticket classification. Analyzes 23 million tickets per year with 95% accuracy
• Collaborated with data science team to establish ML development lifecycle process. Built CI/CD deployment pipeline and monitoring for ML models & operational safety
• Deployed on serverless AWS Fargate scaled to handle 533 TPS, 10k TPS burst

Platform Expansion Project
• Spearheaded cross-team expansion of product platform to 2 new gov’t customers. Drove alignment of management and engineer stakeholders on program’s technical vision
• Streamlined deployment pipelines to reduce platform expansion time by 60%, expediting feature delivery time to customers. Received internal organization award for this

Operational Sustainability
• Mentored 4 new-hires, each ramped up within 15 business days and joined oncall rotation within 6 weeks. Technical advisor to 3 projects
• Migrated legacy website tech stack to serverless AWS Lambda and integrated enterprise single-sign-on with OIDC. Deprecated dated hardware with 0 downtime
• Led Python runtime project to upgrade software version across 10 live services

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
• First author on academic research paper in collaboration w/ Intel Labs & university. Presented work at HPC conferences (IPDPS, SIAM PP)
• Improved state-of-the-art computational algorithm up to 33.35x speedup on GPUs
• Handled large dataset processing of real-world data scaled to 4.92 TB/s throughput
• Proposed novel data structure design and open-source engineering implementation 
• Tech stack: OpenMP & CUDA C/C++, GPUs (V100, A100) and heterogeneous compute
positions.insights: Scholarly Research and High Performance Computing (HPC)
